entity: Delaware's share of billion-dollar business bankruptcies filed since 2015
why: The Texas Lawbook (Debtwire) has SDTX taking 54 of 115 $1B+ cases with Delaware at only 27 in the overlapping period — opposite leader and far more than 25% off our 57.5%. Cornerstone (40%) and Bloomberg (39%) also sit well below our share. The 'Delaware leads' direction matched in two sources; the share did not.
